_about: Public-domain W. H. Fremantle, Dean of Ripon and broad-church writer, for the Word Hoard: The World as the Subject of Redemption (his Bampton Lectures), The Gospel of the Secular Life, Church Reform, Christian Ordinances and Social Progress, Natural Christianity, sermons and essays, and his Recollections. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 121 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

fremantle-commerce: The Influence of Commerce Upon Christianity: A Prize Essay, Read in the Theatre, Oxford, June 28 (T. and G. Shrimpton, 1854)
fremantle-secular-life: The Gospel of the secular life, sermons preached at Oxford : with a prefatory essay (London : Cassell, 1882)
fremantle-universal-priesthood: Sermon on the universal priesthood of believers (Oxford, 1882)
fremantle-redemption: The world as the subject of redemption : being an attempt to set forth the functions of the church as designed to embrace the whole race of mankind : eight lectures delivered before the University of Oxford in the year 1883 on the foundation of the late Rev. John Bampton (London : Rivington's, 1885)
fremantle-patriotism: Patriotism and cosmopolitanism, a sermon for the Peace Conference, preached in the English Church at the Hague, Sunday, May 28th, 1899 (Ripon, Thirlway, 1899)
fremantle-ordinances: Christian ordinances and social progress (Boston ; New York : Houghton, Mifflin and Company, 1901)
fremantle-natural-christianity: Natural Christianity (London ; New York : Harper and Brothers, 1911)
fremantle-recollections: Recollections of Dean Fremantle, chiefly by himself (London, New York : Cassell, 1921)
